title: Deploy and leg2 broadcast entries are non-idempotent with no resume path: a halted/partial broadcast leaves half-wired or terminally-Migrating mainnet state, and re-running the documented command does not recover it
location: DeployTempStableStakerAndMigrators.s.sol:195-239 (no post-conditions, no resume); Leg2Migration.s.sol:188-217 (always calls initiateMigration first, no Active/Migrating branch)
description: Two related non-idempotent halt-states in the suite's operational robustness, distinct from the mid-suite reset halt (YS-09). (A) DEPLOY: the script's only guards are pre-flight; after 5 deployments and 11 mutations it asserts nothing and prints 'BROADCAST complete'. Under --skip-simulation + Ledger, a mid-sequence failure leaves e.g. phUSD.setMinter(temp,true) applied but migrators unset, with no idempotent re-run (re-running redeploys all five contracts, orphaning the JSON consumers' addresses). (B) LEG2: the broadcast uses --skip-simulation; if it halts after Step 1 initiateMigration(DOLA/USDC) but before all migrate chunks land, the temp pools are left in PoolState.Migrating, and re-running the SAME documented command reverts at the first action ('StableStaker: pool not active'). The migrate loop itself IS idempotent (batchMigrate skips amount==0), so a resume branch is feasible — it just isn't implemented. The project's own story-055 ResumeStableStakerMigration exists precisely because this failure mode is real.
impact: Operational: partially-wired or terminally-Migrating mainnet state with a stale/absent deployments JSON; recovery requires out-of-band cast calls (migrator2.migrate(token, remaining) for leg2; manual re-wire for deploy) under incident pressure. Funds not lost (idle pile + snapshot credit intact; migrate replay-safe per user).

classification.assetImpact: No fund loss (idle pile + snapshot credit intact; per-user migrate is replay-safe). A halted/partial deploy or leg2 broadcast leaves half-wired or terminally-Migrating mainnet state with a stale/absent deployments JSON; recovery requires out-of-band cast calls.
attackPath: 1. Deploy: only pre-flight guards; a mid-sequence failure under --skip-simulation+Ledger leaves e.g. setMinter applied but migrators unset, with no idempotent re-run (re-running redeploys all five contracts, orphaning JSON consumers).
2. Leg2: --skip-simulation halt after initiateMigration but before all migrate chunks land leaves temp pools Migrating; re-running the same command reverts 'pool not active'.
classification.likelihood: Low — requires a broadcast halt; the migrate loop itself is idempotent so a resume branch is feasible but unimplemented.
classification.assumptions: story-055 ResumeStableStakerMigration precedent shows this failure mode is real; funds not lost.
classification.externalRequirements: A broadcast interruption plus out-of-band recovery.

evidence: Deploy: source lines 195-239 (no requires after wiring); intent.md 'Declared post-conditions: None'; sibling ResumeStableStakerMigration.s.sol (story 055). Leg2: StableStaker.sol initiateMigration require(poolState==Active) verified; Leg2Migration.s.sol always calls initiateMigration before the migrate loops with no Active/Migrating branch; batchMigrate skips amount==0 positions.
recommendation: Deploy: append a _postVerify() (pattern exists in ReplaceSYAMainnet.s.sol) re-reading every mutated slot and the five deployments before writing the JSON; add an idempotent guard that skips deployment if a valid ys-swap-deployments.json already exists. Leg2: add a resume-aware branch in run() — before Step 1, read tempStaker.poolState(token); if already Migrating, skip initiateMigration and proceed directly to the replay-safe migrate loop; optionally persist a progress.<chainId>.json marker.
dedupNotes: MERGED two raw Low candidates of one operational-robustness family: deploy F6 (idx5, MissingPostConditions / no-resume) and leg2 idx2 (NonIdempotentBroadcastNoResume). Both are non-idempotent-broadcast / no-resume halt-states with the same fix shape (resume-aware guards + post-conditions) and the same story-055 precedent. Canonical entryPoint = migrate:ys-swap-deploy with leg2 as a cross-entry-point instance. The reset-entry instance is DELIBERATELY NOT merged here — it is YS-09 (Medium) because its halt lands mid-suite on-chain after users are parked and is griefable via the story-010 gate, a materially more severe halt-state than these two.
sanitizationReason: New entry point migrate:ys-swap-deploy (with leg2 cross-instance). Non-idempotent broadcast / no-resume operational-robustness family. Deliberately NOT merged into YS-09 (reset halt is more severe). Non-obvious operator footgun, not KI. NEW.
severityJustification: Operational-robustness footgun (non-idempotent broadcast / no resume path) distinct from and less severe than the mid-suite reset halt (YS-09): a partial deploy/leg2 halt leaves half-wired or Migrating state recoverable only via out-of-band cast calls, but funds are not lost and the halt is not mid-suite-after-users-parked. Low operational hazard with a clear resume-aware fix shape.
crossLinks: YS-13 <-> YS-01 <-> YS-09: YS-13 is the deploy/leg2 non-idempotent-broadcast no-resume family; deliberately NOT merged into YS-09 (reset halt is more severe) nor YS-01 (vault-call bug).
